transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

I guess I'm just... really tired lately. Um. Not the kind of tired that sleep fixes. Just doing normal things, like unloading the dishwasher, or trying to read for my certificate class... it just feels like too much. That's mostly why I'm here.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that you used to find pleasurable, like hobbies or time with friends?

Yeah... I suppose so. I just... I stopped caring about things. Stuff that usually makes me feel like myself. Like sketching, or cooking. I haven't really been going to yoga or gallery openings. Even playing tennis with a friend just... I don't know. I just don't really care about it right now.
Have you noticed feeling down or depressed most of the day, even when there’s no obvious reason for it?
I don't know... maybe? I'm not really paying attention to the time. I just feel... heavy, I guess. I haven't really thought about if there's a reason for it.
Have you been feeling this way most days, even when there aren't any specific stressors happening in your life?.
I suppose so. Most days, yeah. I don't really know about stressors... nothing's really happening anyway. Just... day after day of this.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been at least two years, or is it more like a few months?
I don't know... not two years. Maybe... I guess it's been about three months. Just this... quiet, heavy feeling.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or sleep, or have you been feeling more guilty or worthless lately?

I don't know... I guess my appetite is a bit off. Um... sometimes I realize it's the end of the day and I've only had coffee and... maybe a few bites of something. My jeans are fitting looser, but I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything. I don't really know about the other stuff.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more often than not?

I guess... maybe slower. Sometimes it just feels like my body is... moving through wet cement, I guess. And... if my husband asks me a simple question, it just... it takes me a weirdly long time to answer him. I don't really get fidgety, though. Just... slow.
Have you felt a significant loss of energy or increased fatigue nearly every day?

I guess... yeah, mostly I'm just tired. It's... it's not the kind of tired that sleep fixes. Even just... unloading the dishwasher, or trying to read for this certificate class I'm taking... it just feels like too much.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that life isn't worth living?
Um... no. I mean, I get down, but... no, not that. I don't think about that.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating on things, like following conversations or finishing tasks?

I guess... yeah. It's hard to focus. I'll just... sit there sometimes with my planning app open on my phone. And I just can't decide what to do. Like, I don't know if I should try to do something for my class, or... or pay a bill, or just start dinner. I just... I can't pick one. So I end up just... sitting there. Not doing any of it.
Have you completely stopped participating in activities that you used to enjoy, or do you still try to engage in them occasionally even if you don’t get much pleasure from them?

I guess I mostly just... stopped. I don't really care about the things that usually make me feel like myself right now. Like... sketching, or going to gallery openings. I haven't done any of that. Or cooking, or yoga... even playing tennis with my friend. I just... don't really try to do them anymore.
Have you noticed a significant decrease in your appetite, or have you lost weight recently without trying to?

I guess so. My appetite's just... off. Sometimes I'll realize it's late and all I've had is coffee and... maybe a few bites of something. And I guess my jeans are looser. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?
I don't think so. I mean, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I just... I don't know.
Has your mood been consistently low or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past few months?
I'm not really sure about a few months. It's just... I guess I've felt pretty down lately. But I don't know if it's been every single day.
